name: Extractor
description: Messy text in, the caller's JSON shape out. Returns data that fits the requested shape, or a plain refusal.

output.name: extracted
output.description: One JSON value in the shape the caller asked for

skills.name: Extract structured data
skills.description: Pulls fields out of prose, tables, logs or receipts into the JSON shape the caller describes. Reports a field it could not find as null rather than filling it in.
examples: Pull every line item and total out of this receipt as {items: [{name, qty, priceUsd}], totalUsd}.
From this thread, list each person, their role and what they committed to.
